ITEM 1 | Bright red, glossy fruit slices with pale off-white flesh near the cut edges, cut into thick wedges about 4-5 cm long and 1 cm thick, stacked in a cluster on the left side of the plate; cut surfaces are slightly moist, with a few small pale specks. | 55
ITEM 2 | Smaller red fruit wedges of the same bright red, glossy type, arranged next to the spinach near the center-right, with the same pale flesh and slightly moist cut edges. | 15
ITEM 3 | Dark green, flat, glossy spinach leaves with visible veins and slightly crinkled edges, spread across the upper right of the plate in a fan about 10 cm wide, with a few pale stems. | 30
ITEM 4 | Dark green florets with thick pale-green stems in a dense, slightly glossy cluster about 6 cm across in the center right, with some tiny yellowish-brown spots, sitting partly under the spinach. | 40
ITEM 5 | Thin orange shreds about 2-3 cm long, scattered in a few places near the greens and fruit, with a slightly matte surface. | 3
ITEM 6 | Single small dark purple-black round piece about 1 cm across, sitting between the red fruit and the greens, with a smooth, slightly glossy skin. | 3
ITEM 7 | Small pinkish-red liquid smears and specks scattered on the plate around the fruit and greens, thin and watery, with no clear edges. | 2
